name: webster
description: Production documentation for an app you built, in a fixed layout modelled on Harvester: subject-first directories and a Docusaurus site whose navigation is the filesystem. Every page declares its content type, with sections from The Good Docs Project and quality checks from the ISO/IEC/IEEE 26514 characteristics: type mixing, alt text, heading order and reading grade. Extracts the reference material, anchors every claim to a file and line, measures drift against a recorded manifest, and refuses to state what it could not check.
